name: sorin_vampire_lord_minus_eight_grants_each_vampire
notes: Printed: '[-8]: Until end of turn, each Vampire you control gains "{T}: Gain control of target creature."' The -8 itself targets nothing: the target belongs to the granted ability, chosen when a Vampire activates it (CR 602.2b). Sorin at 8 loyalty uses the -8 from his controller's menu, which asks no target; his controller's Vampire then taps to gain control of the opponent's Bear; the opponent's Vampire gets nothing. Before 2026-11-12 the -8's activation opened the granted ability's 'target creature' slot as its own and granted the ability to the creature designated there instead of to each Vampire (query.activation_target_slots walked into the granted ability): the menu's -8 asks a target there, and the pack has no word for it.
